title: The Sower
reflectionText: The same seed fell on every kind of ground, and the difference was never in the seed — it was in what the ground was ready to do with it. The word came the same to the hardened path and to the good soil. What is it that turns a life into ground where something can finally take root and grow?
editorialNotes: Wave 1d (Full-Canon Production Gate CG17). Matthew 13:1-23, adult lane absent (kid 'The Farmer and the Seeds' exists); owner-chosen anchor is the full 1-23 (parable + interpretation) over Mark 4:1-9. SHORT + FULL: the SHORT centers on the parable plus the 'why parables / blessed are your eyes' frame (WEB 317w / KJV 301w); the FULL adds Jesus's interpretation of the four soils, the explanatory dialogue compressed into spoken retelling rather than reproduced verse by verse (WEB 528w / KJV 502w). No Long. No invented detail; boundary v23.
